angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 467,510 km at 73.41 pc = 0.09 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 13.6226 +/- 0.0147 mas (same row, RUWE 1.19): 73.41 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.672 +/- 0.01 solar radii from Lam et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1260 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.519.1437L/abstract): 467,510 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.679 +/- 0.095 solar masses from Lam et al. 2023, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-1260 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.519.1437L/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4227 +/- 85 K from Lam et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1260 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.519.1437L/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Lam et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1260 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.519.1437L/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-1260.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.615, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1260 (pscomppars): spectral type K6 V, from Georgieva et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021MNRAS.505.4684G/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, LP 62-217: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1260 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.1 dex, from Lam et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.519.1437L/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1260 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.88941, from Lam et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.519.1437L/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1260 (pscomppars): age 6.7 Gyr, from Lam et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.519.1437L/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1260 (pscomppars): rotation period 30.63 d, from Lam et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.519.1437L/abstract)
